title: The Great Stone Face, and Other Tales of the White Mountains
sourceTitle: The Great Stone Face, and Other Tales of the White Mountains
author: Nathaniel Hawthorne
description: "The Great Stone Face, and Other Tales of the White Mountains" by Nathaniel Hawthorne is a collection of fictional tales likely written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: This work revolves around themes of nature's majesty and human aspirations, with a focus on the iconic Great Stone Face in New Hampshire, which serves as a symbol of nobility and virtue.
